Gmail sweep 10 Nov 2026 (18 months, two queries, 1379 messages read by header)

Gmail sweep 10 Nov 2026, before 10 May 2025 (two queries: case terms and public-sector senders): 102 case-term messages read by header; 1 is case correspondence with a body (added); the rest are other matters or private individuals, left out. 776 public-sector messages with no case term were not opened (other matters).
Newer messages and open outcomes read 10 Nov 2026 (Gmail, read-only): 47 newer messages in indexed threads and the replies behind 12 not-checked requests, classified from the body's own words.

rules.accounted: A request is accounted for when the body gave an end answer (disclosed, refused, not held, destroyed, transferred, fee or clarification demanded, letter only). No reply, an acknowledgement only and anything not checked are open.
rules.present: A present marks an actual record sent as an email attachment (a map, a deed, a photograph, a released document or data file), not a reply letter, leaflet, form or the requester's own file. Anything the import could not tell apart is marked not checked.
rules.not_checked: Where the mail did not show the outcome, the request is marked not checked; nothing is guessed.
